Data Centers Face Scrutiny Over Power Consumption and Land Use

Data centers, increasingly vital for technologies like AI, are drawing attention for their significant energy consumption and demands on power grids. Some reports highlight that these facilities consume resources comparable to cities and argue they should contribute financially in a similar manner. Concerns have been raised about 'phantom' data centers potentially demanding more power than necessary. The expansion of these centers is also impacting land use and has become a factor in political races, such as in Nevada. Meanwhile, the United States is reportedly engaged in a struggle over data center development while China is rapidly expanding its own facilities.
